baseline.note: Windows reproduced the four reported categories and also exposed cancel and late_response at the same earliest boundary. Failure count is therefore six, not four.

earliestBoundary.diagnosticPolicy: Key names and counts only; no environment values, stdout, stderr, usernames, home paths or arbitrary exception text were retained.
earliestBoundary.rootCause: Windows process startup supplemented missing OS environment variables into the fixed child. The child's strict four-key allowlist correctly refused the supplemented key set before any scenario code ran.

developmentFailures.phase: first checker run after provisional environment fix
developmentFailures.cause: The caller environment contains a case-insensitive PATH/Path duplicate; the provisional parent helper validated the entire caller environment and rejected it before reading SystemRoot.
developmentFailures.repair: The final parent helper reads only SystemRoot, while the isolated child still validates its complete environment strictly before clearing placeholders.
developmentFailures.note: The provisional helper performed descriptor-bound checks across the caller environment without selecting, logging, returning, persisting or using any value. The final implementation does not scan unrelated caller environment values.

remainingLimits: Windows symlink-capability tests remain unavailable in this sandbox; their eight EPERM failures are preserved rather than relabelled passing.
Real remote revocation, remote cancellation and native credential containment remain unverified.
The repair proves the fixed independent Node-peer rehearsal on this Windows environment, not Linux, native Codex, provider authentication or production credential handling.
A future Windows/Node change that supplements additional environment keys will fail closed until the explicit policy is reviewed and extended.
